items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: me and Sharky used to talk about you... We used to be, oh, me and Sharky, that'd be like that... We used to buck out there on the lake... Did you play in the same band with Sharky ever? No. We used to buck together all the time.

ctx.x: Is that the area they used to call Meilenburg? The Meilenburg.

Meilenburg. Meilenburg. Yeah. More Road, we'd be out there playing for More Road and then we'd be in all them camp playing across from each other. We used to buck. Bill Gallaty, he ain't long died. He old. All of them dying. Philly Ray. Old timers, you know. Sharky, he left. Sharky used to be out there. We used to be, me and Sharky used to talk about you. Sharky used to say, Glass, you still living you old rascal. We used to be, oh, me and Sharky, that'd be like that. Well you used to mix it up? Yeah, we used to…
